resolved_conflicts.explanation: The provincial dataset calls the Limestone structure a cabin; OpenStreetMap tags the site as an observation tower. The story follows the provincial label and mentions the OpenStreetMap tag.

notes_for_editor: Build year, height, elevation and active status come only from the Alberta dataset (the same values as our record). Staffing is a single 2010 visit. No fire history, no agency statement and no current access rule was found, so no access fact is recorded. The brief's access 'closed' is not backed by any source I read, and the 2010 account describes visitors signing a book, so please check it against the agency. The 2010 route description is a private industrial road, and the story gives no directions on purpose. The firelookout.ca Alberta index returned no usable text. Web search budget for this tower was used on the two queries.
